court: In the High Court of Madras†

respondents: District Collector Coimbatore district and Others … Respondent(s).
case_number: WP No. 7873 of 2026 and WMP No. 8506 of 2026
advocates: For Respondent(s) : Mr. N. Naveen Kumar Govt Advocate for R 1 to R 5
Mr. Arun Natarajan SGP for R 6
judgment_text:
Prayer : Forbearing the 5th respondent from in any manner laying road in the petitioner temple land belonging to Arulmighu Kariakaliamman Temple, comprised in SF Nos. 356/2A, 356/2B and 357 situated at Kalampalayam Village, Mettupalayam Taluk, Coimbatore district

ORDER

This writ petition has been filed to forbear the fifth respondent from in any manner laying road in the temple land belonging to Arulmighu Kariakaliamman Temple, comprised in SF Nos. 356/2A, 356/2B and 357, morefully disclosed in the prayer to this writ petition.

2. Mr. N. Naveen Kumar, learned Government Advocate accepts notice on behalf of respondents 1 to 5. Mr. Arun Natarajan, learned Special Government Pleader, who accepts notice on behalf of the sixth respondent, on instructions would submit that a road has already been laid and therefore, the prayer sought for in this writ petition has now become infructuous. At the same time, he would submit that the road was laid despite objections given by the Inspector, HR&CE, Mettupalayam.

3. Since the road has already been laid, this writ petition has now become infructuous. However, liberty is granted to the petitioner for removal of the road if so advised by filing the appropriate legal proceedings. Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of. Consequently, connected WMP is closed. No costs.
